newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch NCM resumes Russia export credit insurance.
newsitem.headline: Dutch NCM resumes Russia export credit insurance.

text.p: Dutch trade credit insurer NCM said on Thursday it was resuming export credit insurance cover for Russia after a break of almost five years.
NCM said its decision to resume cover for Russia was prompted by a clear improvement in the economic climate in Russia and in its creditworthiness.
NCM suspended export credit cover for Russia in 1992 when the Soviet Union broke up into separate republics.
It has already resumed cover for the former Soviet Baltic republics and for Kazakhstan and Uzbekhistan.
